cubeon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
cubeon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
cubeon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
cubeon.extras.hide_block_particles.toolt: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
cubeon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
cubeon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.
cubeon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Music & Sounds gets a Music... page: play any built-in track now, or turn one off so the game stops picking it. Nothing changes until you turn a track off.
cubeon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
cubeon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.tooltip: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
cubeon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
cubeon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Sets the three below full screen, one test picture at a time.
A key that opens this screen from the ga: A key that opens this screen from the game. Not bound at first.

Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White back to your display's setup.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Set up for your display. Leave on Auto unless it looks wrong.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Lower it until the logo just disappears into the black.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Raise it until the logo just disappears into the bright square.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Make the card a white that's comfortable to look at for a long time, in the light you play in.

cubeon.extras.chat_indicator.tooltip: The coloured bar at the left of a chat line.

cubeon.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: In a world, another controller can join as a new player: press A when it asks, then pick a profile and where to play.
